recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed unless a future work-group decision reintroduces DataElement or changes the modern UsageContext/jurisdiction model.
issue_request: FHIR-5376 requested adding useContext [0..*] to StructureDefinition, ValueSet, ConceptMap, and DataElement so extension/conformance metadata could capture realm, locale, discipline, and similar intended contexts.
initial_application: Git commit 8ec1d99d697586c6b520cf455b7a41b5c931cf06 explicitly applied #5376 by adding useContext rows to StructureDefinition, ValueSet, ConceptMap, and DataElement spreadsheets and adding the original use-context value set.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini keeps StructureDefinition, ValueSet, and ConceptMap active, but comments out DataElement. The active resources now express useContext as 0..* UsageContext, and the UsageContext datatype carries an extensible jurisdiction binding for the realm/location portion of the old decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already contains the requested metadata and the only absent requested resource, DataElement, is out of current build scope.
